tool_input.description: Quick scratch test to determine getMatchingMethod ambiguous behavior

result:
Not a git repo (expected per environment info). Only the intended test file exists, scratch files are cleaned up, and all 38 tests pass.

Created `src/test/java/org/apache/commons/lang3/reflect/MethodUtilsAgentTest.java`, a self-contained JUnit 5 test class covering `MethodUtils`: accessible-method lookup, annotation lookup (direct/inherited), matching-method resolution (exact, boxing, no-match, ambiguous-overload `IllegalStateException`, null-class/empty-name errors), annotation-scoped method listing, override hierarchy, and the various `invokeMethod`/`invokeExactMethod`/`invokeStaticMethod`/`invokeExactStaticMethod` paths (varargs, boxing, forced access to a private method, unknown-method `NoSuchMethodException`, null-object `NullPointerException`, and exception wrapping in `InvocationTargetException`). All 38 tests pass via `./_tools/test.sh`.
